{{Quote|The Geonosians' defense gives them excellent cover, but severely limits their mobility. I believe they can be defeated.''"<br />"''Another attack, sir? But&mdash;|Fisto and the clone commander, during the battle on Rishi|<ref name="The Gauntlet of Death" />}}
A '''clone trooper commander''' served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Green Company/Legends|Green Company]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Green Company was sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] to [[Battle of Rishi (Clone Wars)|recapture]] [[Exonium/Legends|exonium]] [[Mining/Legends|mines]] [[Capture of Rishi|taken]] by [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] forces. Upon Green Company's arrival on Rishi, [[Rishii/Legends|Rishii]] [[Chief/Legends|Chieftain]] [[Gwarrk]] ordered the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to attack the exonium mines, but the assault was unsuccessful, and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] soon ordered a retreat. While Gwarrk pushed for another attack, Fisto asked the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] for their best [[Sniper/Legends|sharpshooter]], and the commander selected [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Cooker|2242]]. After seeing Fisto weakening the enemy defenses with 2242's help, the commander rallied their [[Troop/Legends|troops]] and led them in recapturing the mines.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I have looked everyplace! Where is the Jedi?!''"<br />"''Apparently he's begun the attack without us.|Gwarrk and the clone commander, on Fisto's plan|<ref name="The Gauntlet of Death" />}}
A [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone trooper commander]]<ref name="The Gauntlet of Death" /> was one of the many [[Cloning/Legends|clones]]<ref name="Databank" /> of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]].<ref name="clone troopers">{{DB|organization|clonetroopers|clone troopers}}</ref> They were [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]<ref name="Databank" /> to fight for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="clone troopers" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] served in the Republic's [[Green Company/Legends|Green Company]].<ref name="The Gauntlet of Death" /> Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Star Wars Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] forces [[Capture of Rishi|invaded]] the planet [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]]. They took control of the [[Exonium/Legends|exonium]] [[Mining/Legends|mines]] on the planet, since they needed to obtain exonium [[Mineral/Legends|minerals]] for their [[Sonic weapon/Legends|sonic weaponry]]. The clone commander and their [[Company/Legends|unit]] were dispatched to protect the native [[Rishii/Legends|Rishii]] and were ordered not to attack until a [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] arrived. However, Rishii [[Chief/Legends|Chieftain]] [[Gwarrk]] took command and led the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] in an [[Battle of Rishi (Clone Wars)|attack]] on the exonium mines because their people needed the minerals to prepare [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] for the [[Water/Legends|frost]] [[Time/Legends|times]].<ref name="The Gauntlet of Death" />

[[File:Gwarrk_and_Fisto.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The clone commander, Kit Fisto, and Gwarrk convene after recapturing the Rishi mines.]]
Due to the well-prepared defense of the Geonosians, the attack was unsuccessful, and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] ordered a retreat when he arrived on Rishi. Fisto informed the chieftain that the [[Troop/Legends|troops]] were only there for the Rishii's protection from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy]] and stated that no attack should have been made before his arrival. The clone commander informed Fisto that the Geonosians had prepared a well-entrenched defense, but Gwarrk insisted on another attack. Fisto, however, formulated another plan and asked the commander for the company's best [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]], and the commander directed him to trooper [[Cooker|2242]], nicknamed "Cooker." Soon, Fisto went to the entrance of the mines without informing the commander or Gwarrk.

When Gwarrk asked the clone commander where the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] was, the commander told the Chieftain that Fisto had apparently begun an attack, as they were seeing the Jedi through their [[Electrobinoculars/Legends|electrobinoculars]]. Meanwhile, Fisto ordered Cooker to open fire, and the Jedi deflected the shots at the Geonosians with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. When the clone commander saw Fisto fighting, they rallied their troops and departed in [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]] to assist the Jedi [[General/Legends|General]]. By this time, however, the Geonosians had suffered heavy casualties as a result of Fisto and Cooker's combined efforts. The Republic forces&mdash;along with some of the Rishii warriors&mdash;then arrived and attacked the mines, forcing the remaining Geonosians stationed there to flee. Afterward, Gwarrk acknowledged that Fisto was very powerful; they also acknowledged the Jedi's fighting prowess.<ref name="The Gauntlet of Death" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Sir, the Geos are just dug in too deep.|The clone commander, briefing Kit Fisto|<ref name="The Gauntlet of Death" />}}
The clone commander obeyed the orders given to them by their superior [[Officer/Legends|officers]]&mdash;Chieftain Gwarrk and General Kit Fisto. However, despite being ordered not to attack until a Jedi arrived, the commander instead obeyed Gwarrk's orders to begin the battle.<ref name="The Gauntlet of Death" /> They remained quiet when Gwarrk insulted their troops, but after the battle, the Rishii chieftain congratulated the commander on their good work in battle. Like all clones of Jango Fett,<ref name="clone troopers" /> the commander stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall<ref name="Databank" /> and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="Skin" />

==Equipment==
As a member of the Republic's Green Company, the clone commander wore green [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]] and utilized electrobinoculars during the battle on Rishi.<ref name="The Gauntlet of Death" />

==Behind the scenes==
The clone commander appeared in the [[Free Comic Book Day]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] [[The Gauntlet of Death|''The Clone Wars: The Gauntlet of Death'']], written by [[Henry Gilroy]], illustrated by [[Ramón Pérez|Ramón K. Pérez]], and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="The Gauntlet of Death" /> on [[May 2]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dark Horse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/16-214/Free-Comic-Book-Day-2009-Star-Wars-The-Clone-Wars-DH-All-Ages-Split-Issue|text=Free Comic Book Day 2009 Star Wars: The Clone Wars/DH All Ages Split Issue}}</ref>
